page_title: HEI 1-1 WOL | Heidenheim v Wolfsburg 20/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+3' Niko Kovac decides to make a substitution. Yannick Gerhardt will be replaced by Kofi Jeremy Amoako (Wolfsburg).
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' The corner is swung in but Wolfsburg can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
89' The referee signals a substitution. Nikola Dovedan (Heidenheim) is brought on as a substitute for Jan-Niklas Beste.

86' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) fires the ball towards goal from just outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar after coming very close to hitting the roof of the net. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.
85' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
85' Dzenan Pejcinovic (Wolfsburg) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
84' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the bottom right corner, but Kevin Muller has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
82' Frank Schmidt prepares a substitution. Eren Dinkci is replaced by Florian Pick (Heidenheim).

79' Close! Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) unleashes a rocket of a shot from the edge of the box and his shot flies just a few inches over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.

78' A bullet header by Dzenan Pejcinovic (Wolfsburg) from inside the box has the power, but goes totally in the wrong direction, yards wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.
76' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Sebastiaan Bornauw walks off the pitch to be replaced by Maxence Lacroix (Wolfsburg).
76' Here is a change. Vaclav Cerny is going off and Niko Kovac gives the last tactical orders to Dzenan Pejcinovic (Wolfsburg).
76' Kevin Sessa (Heidenheim) has an effort on goal, but he misses to the right of the goal. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolfsburg.
75' Heidenheim keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
74' The current number of offsides is 1:1.
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Kevin Sessa (Heidenheim) replaces Lennard Maloney.
70' Heidenheim have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
66' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Heidenheim players look gutted.
64' Wait! Referee Timo Gerach has indicated he is going to review the Heidenheim goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
63' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) celebrates a beautiful goal. He wins the ball inside the box from the free kick and plants a header inside the left post. 1:1.
63' Heidenheim can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
62' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg) comes onto the pitch so that Jakub Kaminski can be given a rest.

62' A bullet header by Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) from inside the box has the power, but goes totally in the wrong direction, yards wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolfsburg.
60' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) bursts into the box, cuts inside his man and sends an effort well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.
58' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
57' The goalkeeper is not tested by the free kick from the edge of the box by Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) as his effort only hit the wall.
57' A player from Wolfsburg commits a rough challenge. Timo Gerach blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. A free kick to Heidenheim.
53' Joakim Maehle (Wolfsburg) hammers the ball towards the roof of the net, but it's not so easy to put it beyond Kevin Muller, who denies him with a terrific save.
50' A spell of possession for Wolfsburg in an attempt to control the game.
46' Vaclav Cerny (Wolfsburg) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles past the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.
46' Niko Kovac makes a half-time substitution. Tiago Tomas comes on in place of Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Heidenheim, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
45+4' Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) has too much to say to the referee and receives a yellow card.
45+3' Niko Kovac appears to have said too much and referee Timo Gerach comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
45+2' 1 - 1 This is definitely not what Moritz Jenz (Wolfsburg) wanted. Attempting to intercept an offensive pass, he scored an own goal and made it 1:1.
45+1' The game is interrupted now, Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.

44' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) jumps high after collecting a perfect cross and strikes with a bullet header! His effort goes miles wide of the goal. Poor header! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolfsburg.
43' The free kick is taken by Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim), but ball is cleared.
43' Timo Gerach interrupts the game. One of the players from Wolfsburg won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Heidenheim are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
38' Vaclav Cerny (Wolfsburg) is caught offside!
34' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Wolfsburg, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

31' Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the left side of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
31' Heidenheim will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
30' Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles past the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.
29' Jakub Kaminski (Wolfsburg) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles past the right post. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.
28' A cross by Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
28' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

26' Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) climbs high to connect with a perfect cross and produces a header that goes not far wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.
25' Good work from Wolfsburg as they win a corner.
23' The Heidenheim players’ celebrations are quickly cut short after referee Timo Gerach signals NO GOAL following the VAR review due to an offside.
22' The Heidenheim players celebrate the goal but the referee immediately signals a VAR review. Let's see what happens. Big moment in the game.
21' Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) pounces on a rebound inside the box from a Tim Kleindienst shot and sends the ball into the back of the net. The score is 1:1.

21' Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.
19' Yannick Gerhardt (Wolfsburg) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Kevin Muller intercepts the ball.
17' Patrick Mainka (Heidenheim) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.
13' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
12' The free kick from long range, taken by Wolfsburg, is overhit and the ball goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.
12' Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) brings an opponent down and Timo Gerach interrupts the game.
10' Heidenheim spell of possession comes to an end after a mistake.
7' 0 - 1 Goal! Jonas Wind shows great vision to find Vaclav Cerny (Wolfsburg) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the bottom left corner. 0:1.
5' Adrian Beck (Heidenheim) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
4' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
4' The Heidenheim players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Heidenheim will take the kick-off.
Timo Gerach will officiate today.
